narrative:
Hocking County has 17,548 registered voters, with 15.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 27.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.4%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 23.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.8% of registrants.
